name: RGH + Inventure
description: Ramagondanahalli Government School (RGH) is a government school in Whitefield, Bengaluru, run as a model English-medium school through a public–private partnership with the Government of Karnataka. It has grown from about 200 students in 2019 to nearly 800.

name: Mitti Cafe
description: Mitti Café is a Bengaluru-born social enterprise whose cafés are run entirely by adults with physical, intellectual and psychiatric disabilities, giving them paid work and training in hospitality.

name: Hack Club
description: Hack Club is a global nonprofit network of teen-led coding clubs. Its Daydream game jam brings thousands of high schoolers together in over 100 cities to build their own games.

name: RGH BA Program
description: A programme at Ramagondanahalli Government School (RGH), a government school in Whitefield, Bengaluru, run as a model English-medium school through a public–private partnership with the Government of Karnataka.

name: CodeDay
description: CodeDay is a nonprofit that runs 24-hour events where students build apps and games together, with no coding experience needed. It holds beginner-friendly CodeDays across India, including in Bengaluru.
